A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the incidence of ALNM is high in patients with invasive ductal carcinoma, especially in patients with high-grade tumors.

we can predict with high accuracy whether patients with invasive breast cancer have ALNM, which can guide the surgical management of the disease.
